notes: Defect: promo code discount amount is missing or incorrect in the Mozio email confirmation specifically for return-trip tickets. The code path flows through create-reservations mappers (which swap from/to stations for return trips via getTripData), then through apply-report-discounts.service (which applies promo/discount amounts to the dispatch report), then through map-line-item-return-trip-modification (which modifies line items for return trips), and finally through mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch (which renders the discount into the sanitized dispatch sent to Mozio for email confirmation). The return-trip-specific mapper or discount applier is likely dropping or miscalculating the discount amount for return-trip dispatches.

notes: Openspec provided empty acceptance criteria, so all criteria were authored from scratch based on the story description and technical notes. I traced the data flow through the five listed files and created criteria that verify the discount amount survives each stage: (1) after apply-report-discounts, (2) after map-line-item-return-trip-modification, (3) after mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch, (4) after station-swap in create-reservations mappers, and (5) in the final webhook payload. I added regression criteria for one-way trips, a zero-discount edge case, an over-discount edge case, and a no-promo baseline to ensure the fix doesn't introduce side effects. All criteria are expressed as observable outcomes (Given/When/Then) with no implementation instructions.

after.description: [Mozio] - The Promo code amount is NOT displayed as expected for Return trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation. The discount amount shown in the Mozio email confirmation is incorrect or missing specifically for return trip tickets, while outbound/one-way tickets display the promo code amount correctly. The defect traces through the five-stage data flow: create-reservations mappers (which handle return-trip station swapping) → apply-report-discounts (which applies promo discounts to the report price) → map-line-item-return-trip-modification (which transforms line items for return trips) → mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch (which builds the final dispatch payload sent to Mozio for email generation). The discount is likely lost or miscalculated during the return-trip line item modification step.
